slots.name: title
slots.about: the large title

slots.name: name_label
slots.about: the name field's label

slots.name: phone_label
slots.about: the phone field's label

slots.name: addr_label
slots.about: the one-line address field's label

slots.name: street_label
slots.about: the street field's label (by-hand mode)

slots.name: city_label
slots.about: the town field's label (by-hand mode)

slots.name: post_label
slots.about: the postcode field's label (by-hand mode)

slots.name: min_phone
slots.about: the fewest characters a phone number needs

slots.name: empty_error
slots.about: the error under an empty required field after a save

slots.name: phone_error
slots.about: the error under a short phone number after a save; may read min_phone

slots.name: fix_line
slots.about: the line over the fields after a failed save; may read miss_count (fields that need a look)

slots.name: manual_label
slots.about: the link under the address; may read manual (by-hand mode on)

slots.name: pref_label
slots.about: the switch row's words

slots.name: saved_title
slots.about: the heading once saved

slots.name: saved_line
slots.about: the line under it; may read last_line (the address in one line), last_pref, first_line (the first-choice address) and saved_count

slots.name: set_name
slots.about: {event}: the name field sends its text

slots.name: set_phone
slots.about: {event}: the phone field sends its text

slots.name: set_addr
slots.about: {event}: the one-line address field sends its text

slots.name: set_street
slots.about: {event}: the street field sends its text

slots.name: set_city
slots.about: {event}: the town field sends its text

slots.name: set_post
slots.about: {event}: the postcode field sends its text

slots.name: set_pref
slots.about: {event}: the switch sends on or off

slots.name: toggle_manual
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: swaps the one-line address for street, town and postcode and back; the one line carries into an empty street

slots.name: save
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: keeps the address when every required field holds; otherwise shows the errors

slots.name: again
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: from the saved state back to an empty form

empty.shows: every field quiet, no errors yet, save dimmed

attention.shows: a line over the fields counts what needs a look; each failing field says why in words; each error clears as its field holds

fallback.shows: street, town and postcode in place of the one-line address; the one line carries into an empty street

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops rise, swap and shrink
accessibility.not_colour_alone: each error is words on its field, the summary has an icon and a count, save dims and does nothing until the form holds
